echo "=== WMS GetMap response body (the 'image') ==="; cat /tmp/wms.png; echo; echo "=== GetMap with a concrete leaf layer ==="; python3 -c "
import re
# fetch caps to find a real leaf layer name
" ; curl -s -m 60 "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities" -o /tmp/wmscaps.xml; python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/wmscaps.xml').read()
# leaf layers are <Layer> without nested <Layer>
# crude: collect all Names
names=re.findall(r'<Name>([^<]+)</Name>',d)
# print unique non-group candidates
seen=[]
for n in names:
    if n not in seen: seen.append(n)
print(seen[:25])
"
